snippet.title: Stationbreak: Starlight & Point Defence
snippet.description:
Build a space station. Hold off the swarm. Take what you can and jump.


Wishlist on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4183580/Stationbreak/

Join the Discord:
https://discord.gg/WN3mHn25Dx



---

In this devlog I talk about the latest progress on Stationbreak, a sci-fi roguelite about building temporary space stations while fleeing an unstoppable energy-hungry swarm.

This update focuses on three major areas:

• New defence systems; point defence turrets and shields
• Visual iteration on station modules to better communicate the game’s intended aesthetic
• A more intersting starlight and shadow system, where solar power, heat, and radiators depend on exposure (and proximity) to the star

I also reflect on recent in-person playtests and how the UI needs to do a much better job of guiding new stationbreakers.

Stationbreak is a game about buying time, making tradeoffs, and deciding what’s worth saving before the swarm arrives.

More soon!
